description:
Question: are the mobile journeys and proposed household, February cutoff/opening, preferences and FIFO rules suitable?
Artifact: mobile prototype and explicit approved setup assumptions. Qualifying prior-season holders applying before February 1 have priority; at/after-cutoff returning applicants join ordinary submission order.
Criteria: record owner review before dependent interface/domain work. Verification: recorded owner decision.
Prerequisites: prototype. Stage-1 limitation: ordinary ticket; approval gate is not automatically enforced.
title: Checkpoint: first-version mobile journeys and allocation assumptions
